AccessMode.description: How the run reaches the code under test. Only `repo` is accepted in v1 (ADR-0004).

oneOf.description: A live URL; kept in the schema, rejected by intake in v1.
A repository plus a live URL; kept in the schema, rejected by intake in v1.

BlobRef.description: A content-addressed blob reference, written as `sha256:<hex>`.

Host.description: The host the run happened on, for explanation only.

RepoRef.description: Where the code under test came from.

commit_sha.description: The commit that was exported to the working copy.

RunId.description:
A run identifier: `run_<26 base32 chars>`.

Hashed from the run manifest with the `run_id` field removed.

ServerClock.description: How the server's clock behaves during the run.

oneOf.description: Started at `frozen_clock` and left advancing (Linux only, ADR-0022).
The host's real clock; clock-dependent checks report not_measured.

ToolVersion.description: The version of a tool found on `PATH`.

description: Every pinned input, and nothing that depends on where the run was invoked.

as_of.description: The instant every relative date is computed from.

egress_enforced.description: Whether egress was actually enforced; false on the host runner (ADR-0003).

frozen_clock.description: The clock value pinned for the browser and, when supported, the server.

locale.description: The locale forced on the browser, normally `"en-US"`.

master_seed.description: The master seed all generator seeds derive from.

models.description: Model IDs, empty while the agent layer is off (ADR-0006).

provenance_rules_hash.description:
The provenance rule files hash: `rules/provenance/*.toml` (M1-T11).

Separate from `rule_pack_hash` because the two answer different questions: the pack is
what judges the code, these describe how it was made.

repetitions.description: How many times each action runs; 3, for the 3-of-3 rule.

schema_version.description: The report schema version this run writes.

seeds.description: One seed per random-input generator, sorted by generator name.

server_clock.description: Whether the server clock was moved or left real.

timezone.description: The timezone forced on the app, normally `"UTC"`.

tools.description: Tool versions found on `PATH`, sorted by tool name.
